net/unix: return Unsupported instead of fake root creds on espidf/vita/hurd (#8111)

The no-proc fallback for get_peer_cred currently returns Ok(UCred { uid: 0,
gid: 0, pid: None }) on espidf, vita, and hurd. The signature is
io::Result<UCred>, so the function advertises that it can fail, but the stub
never does. Any caller using peer credentials for an authorization decision
on those targets will silently treat every connecting peer as uid=0/gid=0,
which is the opposite of fail-closed.

Return io::ErrorKind::Unsupported instead so callers must explicitly handle
the lack of SO_PEERCRED support. Callers already handle io::Error from this
function because the non-stub implementations can fail.
